Standalone Iroh/Wormhole pairing candidate

This local candidate is experimental and has not been publicly deployed.
Source: source.tar.gz (SHA-256 082d8419d4ddb8e3e4b1d6f530842094c3ed70b3c6c2c0d98b1c233c6bb16b8a).
Runtime version: 168215132a335a2525532eea.

Third-party components retain their licenses, attribution and notices.

and dated changes are included in source.tar.gz. This is not a VPL-only bundle.
VPL/EUPL compatibility is unresolved. No clearance for combined distribution is
claimed; resolve this before publication. No other project has been relicensed.

Standard Apache-2.0 (enum-assoc) and Unlicense (pharos) supplements are explicitly
identified in the inventory; they are not recovered upstream notice files.
Rust notices are a conservative superset. The relay and mailbox operators can
observe connection metadata. Peer-IP protection is not Tor-like anonymity.
